name: notify-control help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:notify-control (the Notifications panel).
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Notifications
entries.text: Every notification the console, AmberX and axHub can send. Each one has its own switch, channels, priority and a test button.

entries.title: All notifications
entries.text: The master switch. Off silences everything except approvals and veto notices, so you can still stop a held call.

entries.title: Quiet hours
entries.text: Holds phone pushes, sound and pop-ups during these hours, except urgent ones and approvals. A held alert that's still open reaches the phone when they end.

entries.title: Find a notification
entries.text: Filters the list by name, id or where it comes from.

entries.title: Test
entries.text: Sends a real test of this notification down its current channels and says where it went. It clears by itself after 90 seconds.

entries.title: Reset
entries.text: Puts this notification back to its defaults.

entries.title: Reset everything
entries.text: Puts every notification, the master switch and the app switches back to their defaults. Quiet hours stay as they are.

entries.title: Priority
entries.text: Low shows in the banner only. Normal uses every channel that's on and waits out quiet hours. High uses a stronger tone and pop-up. Urgent also goes through quiet hours.

entries.title: Quiet from
entries.text: The time of day quiet hours start or end, in your time zone. Press Save after changing it.

entries.title: Quiet until
entries.text: The time of day quiet hours start or end, in your time zone. Press Save after changing it.
